mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where GDPC1 falls > 2% YoY (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals stronger labor demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS 3-month change > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply-side weakness, which reduces profit margins and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls > 1% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in CPI above 2% signals inflationary pressure, prompting tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL 3-month change > 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and fall in payroll growth (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3% AND PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises > 0.3% AND PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls > 10% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in personal savings rate (implied by RSAFS/GDPC1) signals increased precautionary behavior, which reduces consumer spending and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS/GDPC1 ratio rises > 0.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
